mapper.select: SELECT l.loanId AS loanId, m.memberId AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, r.title AS title, l.resourceId AS resourceId, l.loanDate AS loanDate, l.returnDate AS returnDate FROM loans l JOIN members m ON l.memberId = m.memberId JOIN resources r ON l.resourceId = r.resourceId WHERE m.memberId = #{memberId} ORDER BY loanDate

SELECT l.loanId AS loanId, m.memberId AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, r.title AS title, l.resourceId AS resourceId, l.loanDate AS loanDate, l.returnDate AS returnDate FROM loans l JOIN members m ON l.memberId = m.memberId JOIN resources r ON l.resourceId = r.resourceId WHERE l.loanId = #{loanId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loans ( loanId, memberId, resourceId, loanDate, returnDate) VALUES ( #{loanId}, #{memberId}, #{resourceId}, #{loanDate}, #{returnDate})
